item.title: UN accepts BD's withdrawal of torture convention reservation
item.description: The United Nations (UN) has accepted Bangladesh's proposal to withdraw its declaration under Article 14(1) of the Convention against Torture and Other Cruel, Inhuman or Degrading Treatment or Punishment (CAT), clearing the path to ensuring compensation and rehabilitation rights for victims of state-sponsored torture or enforced disappearance.According to a UN document shared by the Chief Adviser's Press Wing, the proposal came into effect on February 3.Earlier, the Council of Advisers approved t

item.title: Pakistan's India match boycott in solidarity with Bangladesh appropriate: PM Shehbaz

item.title: Mamunul Haque calls for ‘ballot revolution’ to end criminal activity, corruption
item.description: Bangladesh Khelafat Majlis Ameer Maulana Mamunul Haque on Thursday said criminal activity and corruption in Bangladesh would be eliminated through a “ballot revolution” in the upcoming February 12 elections.He made the remarks while addressing a rally at Azim Uddin High School ground in Kishoreganj town. item.title: Unidentified man’s body recovered in Bogura pond
item.description: Police recovered the body of an unidentified man from a pond in Adamdighi upazila of Bogura district on Thursday.The identity of the deceased is yet to be known, aged approximately 35 old.According to locals, they spotted the body floating in a pond near a jute warehouse in Dariapur village of Santahar union around noon and informed police.Being informed, police reached the spot, recovered the body and sent it to Bogura Shaheed Ziaur Rahman Medical College Hospital for an autopsy.Adamdighi Polic

item.title: Tk 1,268.80 cr project aims to shield haor and Barind livelihoods from climate shocks

item.title: Japan to dispatch election observer mission ahead of Feb-12 polls
item.description: Japan has decided to send an Election Observer Mission to monitor the general election scheduled for February 12, reaffirming its support for democratic processes in Bangladesh.According to an official statement, the mission will be deployed from February 9 to February 14 and will be led by Watanabe Masato, former Ambassador of Japan to Bangladesh. item.title: Dhaka air turns ‘very unhealthy’, ranks fourth globally
item.description: Dhaka’s air quality deteriorated sharply on Friday morning, placing the capital fourth on the global list of most polluted cities, with an Air Quality Index (AQI) score of 204 recorded at 9:08 AM, reports UNB.According to the AQI classification, the city’s air was labelled “very unhealthy,” a level that poses serious health risks to the general population. item.title: Over 400,000 postal ballots from expatriates arrive
